identity.one_liner: 为 PostgreSQL 提供 GraphQL 接口的扩展
identity.review: pg_graphql 是一个 PostgreSQL 扩展，从现有 SQL schema 反射生成 GraphQL schema，并在数据库服务器内部完成查询解析，使任何能连接 PostgreSQL 的语言无需额外服务器或库即可通过 GraphQL 查询。每张表在 Query/Mutation 类型中获得分页入口点，支持增删改操作。
highlights: 从现有 SQL schema 反射生成 GraphQL schema
在数据库服务器内完成 schema 转换与查询解析，无需额外服务器或进程
支持通过外键定义关系的分页查询与批量 insert/update/delete 操作
use_cases: 为 PostgreSQL 数据库直接暴露 GraphQL API
多语言客户端通过 GraphQL 查询 PostgreSQL 而不引入额外服务

db_verdicts.quote: # `pg_graphql` ／ `pg_graphql` adds GraphQL support to your PostgreSQL database.

classification.eco_why: 以 PostgreSQL 扩展形式为该数据库提供 GraphQL 能力，属于服务于数据库生态的组件

audit.evidence: `pg_graphql` adds GraphQL support to your PostgreSQL database. ／ `pg_graphql` reflects a GraphQL schema from the existing SQL schema. ／ The extension keeps schema translation and query resolution neatly contained on your database server. This enables any programming language that can connect to PostgreSQL to query the database via GraphQL with no additional servers, processes, or libraries.

identity.one_liner: 为 PostgreSQL 提供透明数据加密（TDE）的扩展
identity.review: pg_tde 是一个 PostgreSQL 扩展，通过提供 tde_heap 访问方法，在文件层面对元组、WAL 和索引进行加密，实现静态数据保护，并支持 keyring 文件和外部 KMS 密钥管理。它仅可与 Percona Server for PostgreSQL 17/18 配合使用，面向需要数据加密能力的 Percona PostgreSQL 用户。
highlights: 提供 tde_heap 访问方法，加密元组、WAL 和索引（L22）
通过 Global Key Provider 接口支持 keyring 文件和外部 KMS（L14）
提供 Docker 运行方式和二进制安装包（L31, L35）
use_cases: 对 PostgreSQL 表数据实施静态数据加密（L8）
通过外部密钥管理系统集中管理加密密钥（L14）
检查表加密状态等辅助管理操作（L51）

db_verdicts.quote: # pg_tde: Transparent Database Encryption for PostgreSQL ／ PostgreSQL extension that provides Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) to protect data at rest. ／ - Works only with Percona Server for PostgreSQL 17 or Percona Server for PostgreSQL 18

classification.eco_why: 该仓库是作为 PostgreSQL 扩展运行、为数据库提供加密功能的组件，而非使用数据库的应用。

Well-known benchmarks, such as TPC-H or TPC-DS, can be executed with a single command and without any preparation. ／ We support a number of benchmarks out of the box. You can run them using the `./hyriseBenchmark*` binaries. ／ Hyrise is developed for Linux (preferrably the most current Ubuntu version) and optimized to run on server hardware. audit.evidence: The main goals of this benchmark are: ／ The test process is documented in the form of a shell script, covering the installation of every system, loading of the data, running the workload, and collecting the result numbers. ／ - `benchmark.sh`: this is the main script which runs the benchmark on a fresh VM; Ubuntu 24.04 or newer should be used by default. It should output the results in the following format: - one or more lines `Load time: 1234` with the time in seconds; - a line `Data size: 1234567890` with the data size in bytes; the data size should include indexes and transaction logs if applicable; - 43 consecutive lines in the form of `[1.234, 5.678, 9.012],` for the runtimes of every query; - the output may include other lines with the logs, that are not used for the report.
